automation_evidence.quote: we propose a systematic multi-agent framework that utilizes an iterative verification loop to synthesize numerically grounded reasoning traces.

evidence.quote:
Impact of event forecasting on performance. Our experiments show that augmenting reasoning
with external search for 𝑋ℎ𝑖𝑠𝑡 and event forecasting for future horizon improves forecasting performance

practical_problems.note: same models run with and without retrieved events; Electricity MASE falls 2.853 to 1.327 but event-aware reasoning hurts Web/CloudOps (Bitbrains 1.123 to 5.460)

evidence.quote:
Robustness. Additionally, we conduct a robustness analysis of the LLM-as-a-Judge (App. E), which
demonstrates a high correlation between independent judge scores

practical_problems.note: judge agreement and a comparison against a human expert panel (70.4% Pearson), plus reasoning-quality versus MASE analysis calibration: LLM-judge reasoning scores; judge agreement is not faithfulness of the agent.

evidence.quote:
Data Integrity and Leakage Prevention. We explicitly distinguish the role of ground truth (𝑌 )
and future events/context across Data Creation Phase and Evaluation Phase.

practical_problems.note: oracle future events are used only to build references and evaluated models see only history; this is a protocol design with no leakage-varying experiment

summary: Provides a reasoning-aware forecasting benchmark whose reference traces come from a search-and-verify multi-agent loop; paired runs show event context helps in energy and traffic but hurts in cloud workloads, and the judge is checked against human experts.
